photos_rejected: A mid-session close-up of fresh linework under plastic wrap with visibly irritated/reddened skin around the tattoo: excluded per the strict 'no fresh-tattoo mid-session, no open-wound-adjacent shots' rule for this niche.

A color portrait (dog in an ornate frame) with visible purple surgical-marker guide lines drawn on the surrounding skin, apparently prepping an adjacent piece: excluded as it reads as an unfinished/in-process shot rather than finished work.

A healed color tattoo of roses on a client's upper thigh, photographed with underwear in frame: excluded as overly intimate framing for a public cold-outreach demo, consistent with the curation precedent on other sites in this registry, even though no skin is exposed inappropriately.
A duplicate crop/resolution of the same chest/torso clown piece already used as gal-clown.jpg: not used a second time.
photo_curation_note: gmaps_detail.js + gmaps_photocycle.js (requested 30, returned 10 new URLs, several of which were re-served duplicates of photos already pulled during an earlier research pass on this same business) together yielded 12 unique photo files after de-duplication by file hash. Every one was opened and visually inspected before selection (not chosen by filename). 8 were judged usable under the niche's strict rules (healed/finished work only, no blood or mid-session shots, no text overlays, no selfies as gallery tiles); 1 photo was reused a second time (hero image also placed in the gallery grid) to fill the skeleton's 6-tile gallery without resorting to a rejected photo, which matches the precedent used on other sites in this registry when the real photo count is limited. No artist selfie was available to place as a small avatar in the Experience section, so a tight crop of the shop's own illuminated sign is used instead as the brand mark throughout (nav, footer, favicon).

reviewSamples.author: nateHuff024
reviewSamples.text: Absolutely nailed my first tattoo, Orlando did an amazing job. I gave him some of my ideas and he got creative and i absolutely love how it turned out. Definitely will be back to continue my sleeve

reviewSamples.author: Lisa Edworthy
reviewSamples.text: First time at Funhouse Tattoos and it will not be our last! Today Friday the 13th I went with my daughter-in-law. First Anna did a double lip piercing for my daughter-in-law. The area was very clean. She talked her through the whole thing.

reviewSamples.author: Denecia W
reviewSamples.text: Beautiful shop, I went in the month of October and it was decorated so spooky and super dope! Very clean as well. My artist was Suji, and she performed ombre semi permanent eyebrows.

reviewSamples.author: Cyprien Pizot
reviewSamples.text: Kevin is an outstanding tattoo artist. From start to finish, everything was perfect, on time, fully set up, and extremely professional. He's very kind, patient, and incredibly talented. The quality of his work is amazing.

reviewSamples.author: Shirley Faustin
reviewSamples.text: Shout out!!! To all the guys and Ladies At FUNHOUSE Tattoos... My 2nd home lmao!!! (not used on site: too short/generic next to the four quotes above that each name a specific artist and service)

dedupe_check: grep -i '954-788-9500\|Funhouse' data/processed.json returned no match before building (re-verified at build time, in addition to the no-match check already done at discovery). output/in-the-flesh-tattoo-pompano, a different Pompano Beach tattoo shop already registered from a prior run, was left untouched; no files under that slug were read or modified.
brand_vibe: The shop's own storefront photo shows an illuminated neon sign reading 'FUNHOUSE TATTOOS' and reviews describe the space as 'decorated so spooky' (Halloween theming) with a dark, moody interior. That, plus the gallery's heavy skull/skeleton/clown/horror-adjacent tattoo subject matter, pointed to the dark-v2 skeleton with a bold crimson/oxblood accent (deep red #c4273f / #8f1b30 over a near-black base) rather than reusing any of the gold/teal/coral/violet accents already used elsewhere in the registry: a classic 'tattoo ink red on black' palette that fits a Pompano Beach tattoo and piercing studio.
